_about: Public-domain Paul Rader, evangelist and pastor of the Moody Church and the Chicago Gospel Tabernacle, for the Word Hoard: Paul Rader's Sermons, How to Win and Other Victory Messages and God's Blessed Man. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 126 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken.

rader-how-to-win: How to win, and other victory messages (New York city, The Book stall, 1919)
